meta.source_name: Texas House Journals / Texas Legislature Online; Vote Smart retained as secondary leads
meta.purpose: Curated machine-readable key and controversial legislative voting record for the Gina Hinojosa Then & Now archival website.
meta.status: first official-verification tranche complete; continuing expansion toward a broader career-wide curated set
meta.scope_note: This is a curated set of high-salience votes, not every roll call during Hinojosa’s House service. Inclusion reflects public significance, issue salience, scorecard/research relevance, unusual vote status, or relationship to documented campaign positions.
curation_method: Select consequential or controversial policy votes across Hinojosa’s service.
Verify each published VERIFIED entry against a Texas House Journal record.
Keep secondary-source leads visible but clearly marked pending until official verification.
Do not infer a Yes/No vote from party, sponsorship, absence, committee membership, or voice votes.
notes: Committee votes and House floor votes must be identified separately.
A vote is never inferred from party, sponsorship, attendance, committee membership, or a voice vote.
Ballotpedia, Vote Smart, and advocacy scorecards identify research leads; official Texas records control verified entries.
